name: Platform Launch
objective: Complete platform launch with all 19 engines at production quality, finalized Rust and TypeScript SDKs, comprehensive API documentation, tiered rate limiting with billing readiness, desktop surface extensions, and public API readiness backed by a security audit

architecture_snapshot.existing_rate_limit: DashMap-based in middleware.rs, per-user rate_limit field
architecture_snapshot.sdk_state: noesis-sdk crate exists (client, profile, keychain, render, config) — not published to crates.io

known_gaps: face-reading engine is mock/stub — needs MediaPipe or image-analysis backend
full-spectrum workflow missing nadabrahman and transits engines
Workflow engine coverage is narrow (birth-blueprint=3, daily-practice=3, decision-support=3, self-inquiry=2, creative-expression=2)
UsageRepository is minimal — only log_usage, no aggregation or billing queries
No developer portal beyond /api/docs Swagger UI
No public changelog or migration guide infrastructure

waves.name: Engine Completion & Workflow Expansion
waves.description: Bring all engines to production quality, expand workflow engine coverage to leverage the full 16-engine complement, and update synthesis modules for richer multi-engine integration

swarms.name: Face Reading Production Backend

tasks.acceptance: ADR has at least 3 options evaluated with a clear recommendation and rationale
tasks.validation: ADR merged to main with team sign-off comment

tasks.validation: cargo test -p engine-face-reading passes with new birth-data-based tests showing deterministic results for same inputs

swarms.name: Security Audit & Hardening
swarms.description: Comprehensive security audit of auth, API, and data layers; fix findings; prepare for public exposure

tasks.title: Run cargo audit and fix all non-ignored advisories
tasks.deliverable: cargo audit runs clean (exit 0) with only pre-approved ignores in .cargo/audit.toml; any new advisories fixed by dependency upgrade or documented with justification
tasks.acceptance: cargo audit exits 0; any new ignores have documented justification in audit.toml comments
tasks.validation: CI cargo audit step passes; audit.toml diff reviewed

tasks.title: Audit JWT token handling for OWASP JWT best practices
tasks.deliverable: JWT implementation audit against OWASP JWT Cheat Sheet: verify algorithm restriction (no 'none'), token expiry enforcement, refresh token rotation, issuer/audience validation, and key management
tasks.acceptance: Audit document lists all checks performed with pass/fail; any findings have corresponding fix PRs
tasks.validation: Security test suite validates: 'none' algorithm rejected, expired tokens rejected, wrong issuer rejected, tampered signature rejected

tasks.title: Add API key scoping and permission model
tasks.deliverable: API keys support scoped permissions: engines:read, workflows:execute, readings:read, admin:* with scope validation in auth middleware; api_keys migration adds scopes column
tasks.acceptance: API key with engines:read scope can call engine endpoints but gets 403 on admin endpoints; scope-less legacy keys get full access for backward compatibility
tasks.validation: Integration tests validate scope enforcement on all endpoint groups; migration runs cleanly

tasks.title: Audit and harden input validation across all API endpoints
tasks.deliverable: All API endpoints validate input size limits (body <= 1MB), string length limits, numeric range bounds, and reject unexpected fields; BirthData.validate() covers all edge cases
tasks.acceptance: Oversized payloads get 413; strings exceeding 1000 chars get 422; latitude/longitude out of range get 422 with specific field error
tasks.validation: Fuzzing test with proptest generates random inputs and validates no panics; all validation error tests pass

tasks.title: Add CORS configuration hardening for production domains
tasks.deliverable: CORS configuration restricts allowed origins to production domains in RUST_ENV=production (selemene.tryambakam.space, admin domain, SDK origins); wildcard only in development mode
tasks.acceptance: Production mode rejects requests from non-allowed origins with proper CORS error; development mode allows all origins
tasks.validation: curl tests with different Origin headers validate CORS behavior in both modes

tasks.title: Implement request signing for SDK-to-API communication
tasks.deliverable: HMAC-SHA256 request signing using API secret key: SDK signs request body + timestamp; server validates signature within 5-minute window; replay attack prevention via nonce tracking
tasks.acceptance: Signed requests accepted; unsigned requests to signing-required endpoints rejected with 401; replayed requests (same nonce) rejected with 409
tasks.validation: SDK tests validate signing flow; server tests validate signature verification, timestamp window, and nonce deduplication

tasks.title: Run npm audit on TypeScript sidecar and admin-web dependencies
tasks.deliverable: npm audit (or bun audit) runs clean on ts-engines and apps/admin-web; critical and high vulnerabilities resolved by upgrade or documented with justification
tasks.acceptance: npm audit reports zero critical and zero high severity issues in both projects
tasks.validation: CI npm audit step passes for both projects
